subject.title: fix(google): use stable Gemini image model

question: Should this PR carry OpenRouter stable Gemini image IDs now, or narrow to the Google and doctor-migration repair while OpenRouter endpoint work lands separately?
rationale: The OpenRouter stable IDs are real, but this branch advertises and migrates them without the endpoint route that the related OpenRouter PRs are trying to add.

options.title: Narrow OpenRouter Out
options.body: Preserve nano-banana Pro and keep this PR focused on Google/default migration, leaving OpenRouter /api/v1/images work to the dedicated OpenRouter PR.

options.title: Carry Full OpenRouter Route
options.body: Require this branch to implement the /api/v1/images request and response path before advertising or migrating stable OpenRouter Gemini IDs.

options.title: Pause For OpenRouter PR
options.body: Hold this PR until the dedicated OpenRouter route PR lands, then rebase the Google/migration portion on top.

recommendation.title: Narrow OpenRouter Out
recommendation.body: Preserve nano-banana Pro and keep this PR focused on Google/default migration, leaving OpenRouter /api/v1/images work to the dedicated OpenRouter PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows broad adjacent ownership across provider routing, model/default cleanup, and compatibility migrations.
